## Educational Treatment Suggestions
- Consider early removal of chest tubes once drainage ceases and lung re-expansion is confirmed.
- Use tunneled lines for prolonged IV therapies to reduce infection risk compared to non-tunneled catheters.
- Remove all indwelling devices when no longer clinically necessary to minimize complications.
